tracks.label: Pinnacle moves alone
tracks.about: Fallback option (NBA live rule since 2026-10-28). Between two reads of a game, Pinnacle's de-vigged chance moves 2+ pts toward a side while the median of the other books (4+, same line) moves under 2 pts, and Hard Rock's price on that side is at or better than Pinnacle's new fair price. Flat 1 unit at Hard Rock's price on the later read.

tracks.label: Pinnacle as the price judge
tracks.about: Fallback option. Hard Rock's price is 2%+ better than Pinnacle's de-vigged fair on the same line (newest read, first flag per player, market and game). Flat 1 unit at Hard Rock's price.
